channel.title: Life in the Simulation
channel.description: Essays, field guides and thought experiments about simulation theory, consciousness, artificial intelligence, attention and living deliberately in a mediated world.

item.title: The Average Is Not the Experience
item.description: An average compresses a distribution into one number. Learn when the mean helps, what it hides, and how to audit spread, tails, groups and time.

item.title: Shared Access Without a Shared Password
item.description: A household protocol for replacing shared logins with individual accounts, bounded roles, official sharing, recovery paths and a tested handoff.

item.title: Portable Monitors Without the Hype: USB-C vs HDMI vs Wireless
item.description: Choose a portable monitor by tracing video, power, touch, brightness, stand and cable compatibility across USB-C, HDMI and wireless paths.

item.title: Attention Is Not Consciousness
item.description: Attention selects what gets processed; consciousness concerns experience. Learn why the two interact without treating either as an explanation of the other.

item.title: Write a Personal Runbook Before the Routine Becomes an Emergency

item.title: Digital Photo Frames Without the Hype: Local Storage vs Cloud vs Smart Display
item.description: Choose a digital photo frame by storage path, remote sharing, privacy, screen fit, account recovery, export options and what still works when the service changes.

item.title: The System Includes the Waiting Time

item.description: Choose home security camera storage by evidence retention, outage behavior, privacy, network compatibility and the failure you actually need to survive.

item.title: Ten Links Can Still Be One Source
item.description: A citation chain can look like corroboration while every link descends from one observation. Learn to map provenance and count independent evidence.

item.title: Build a Notification Escalation Ladder

item.title: Voice Recorders Without the Hype
